reason: I only buy gummies or drinks because I hate swallowing pills, and this is 2 capsules a day. I also have a drawer full of half-used bottles already, so I am not adding another one.
objection: It is capsules, and $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) that I would actually finish. Why pay more for something I have to swallow twice a day?
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or powder-drink version at around $20 a month.
